_comment: Curated paper -> canonical-pipeline pairs. 'query' is a methods-style description as it would be distilled from a paper's Methods section (the methods-extractor stage output). 'target_patterns' are case-insensitive substrings; a retrieved workflow name matching ANY pattern is a correct hit. Pairs whose target is absent from the DB are dropped by the harness (reported).
